				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3><span>YOUR COACH : MATHIEU PASTORINO</span></h3></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_8  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p class="isSelectedEnd" style="text-align: justify;"><strong><span>20+ Years of Experience • Wingfoil Coach • Kitesurf Instructor</span></strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd" style="text-align: justify;"><span>With over 20 years of experience in watersports, Mathieu Pastorino is a passionate waterman who loves sharing his connection with the ocean. As an instructor and Center Manager at ION CLUB Golf de Roses, he has coached riders of all levels with a patient, positive and personalised approach.</span></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd" style="text-align: justify;"><span>At Dakhla Oasis212, Mathieu will guide you to the best spots on the lagoon and adapt each session to your level and goals. Whether you want to improve your skills in kitesurfing or wingfoiling, you’ll benefit from high-level coaching in one of the world’s most spectacular watersports destinations.</span></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><strong><span>Ride with confidence. Progress with passion. Experience Dakhla.</span></strong></p></div>
